A '''[[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]]''' was involved in the late stages of the [[Battle of Kothlis]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. It contained a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] force led by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], at least four [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing]] bombers, and at least three [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]].

After the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']] was shot down by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] over [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], the Rebels, trying to retrieve the data from the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']], which was captured by the ''Motivator'' during the space battle and thus went down with the ship, the transport, escorted by Rogue Squadron, went down to the ''Motivator''{{'s}} crash site on Kothlis. Initially, they intended to land directly on the ''Motivator''{{'s}} wreck, but they eventually were forced to land it far away, although still in close proximity to the ''Motivator'', because of the discovery that the ''Motivator''{{'s}} remains had a core that would go critical within minutes, and thus were unwilling to risk getting the transport destroyed. Afterwards, Rogue Squadron proceeded to defend the transport and commandos while they attempted to enter the ''Motivator''. Upon acquiring the data, the transport picked up the troops and lifted off.

==Behind the scenes==
The transport appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''.
